set_attn_processor: set a custom attention processor on all Attention layers of a diffusers model recursively
fuse_qkv_projections: fuse query, key, and value projection matrices into a single linear layer for faster inference
set_use_memory_efficient_attention_xform: enable xformers memory-efficient attention backend on a diffusers model to reduce GPU memory usage
build_BasicTransformerBlock: build a BasicTransformerBlock with self-attention, cross-attention, and feed-forward layers using ada_norm or layer_norm
create_FeedForward: create a FeedForward layer with configurable activation functions like geglu, swiglu, or gelu-approximate
